title: Europe gains 2% for the week as China's stock slide hits a 12th week and its factories shrink
short: Europe up 2%, China slides for a 12th week as factories shrink
dek: European shares had a strong week despite Friday's tech sell-off. In Asia, Korea and Japan swung on AI news, and China's blue chips fell for a 12th straight week as factory activity slipped into contraction.
card: DAX +2.5%, STOXX 600 +2.1%, Hang Seng +0.87% for the week. China's factory PMI fell to 49.3. What to watch for India.
